title: Leaping the chasm from proprietary to open: A survivor's guide
summary: Bryan Cantrill's OSCON 2015 talk on moving a proprietary product to open source, drawing on Sun's history with Solaris and illumos, licensing choices and the relicensing after Oracle's acquisition.
why: HN commenters cite it for the history of open source at Sun and Oracle, and for Cantrill's explanation of licensing choices.

quote.text: As usual Bryan Cantrill is just brilliant at explaining stuff.
